title: Histor receipt v0.1
description: A signed, hash-chained record of one agent event: who was accountable, which agent acted, under what authority and approval, what it touched, what it cost, and what happened. Signed body = receipt minus `seal` and `proof`.

extensions.description: Vendor extensions, namespaced x-<vendor>. Covered by the signature.

decimal.description: Money and rates are decimal strings; non-integer JSON numbers are forbidden in Histor.

subject_id.description: Stable identifier of the accountable human (IdP subject, employee id or email). Never a shared/service account for principal or approver.

data_residency.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or a named sovereign zone

type.description: Dotted action type, aligned with a shared open action taxonomy where one exists (e.g. filesystem.file.delete).

credential_id.description: Identifier of the credential (key id, client id, role ARN). NEVER secret material.

reversal_of.description: receipt_id of the action this receipt reverses.

terminal.description: Present only on the last receipt of a stream; no receipt may follow (verifiers fail 'receipt after terminal'). Absence means 'no claim'.

status.description: Why the stream ended; only valid with terminal: true.
